analysis_set.span: All analyses were performed according to the intention-to-treat principle and included data from all randomized participants including information collected between the formal interim analysis and final follow-up visits.

follow_up.span: Follow-up was completed on July 05 2022, at which time median follow-up was 2.0 years (interquartile range, 1.5 to 2.4 years).

entry_age.span: Age ≥18 years or at "full age" as required by local regulation

notes: The ITT statement covers all analyses, including the served safety outcome; it is not amputation-specific. Follow-up is trial-wide. Entry criteria remain within adult CKD. Lower-limb amputation is a safety outcome rather than the question's primary cardiorenal composite; the published estimate is HR, not RR.
